newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Gulf basis firm, movement slow.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Gulf basis firm, movement slow.

text.p: Hard red winter wheat bids at High Plains elevators and terminals were mostly steady early Tuesday with only scattered farmer sales out of in-store grain noted so far this week, merchandisers said.

Spot bids at the Texas Gulf firmed one to two cents a bushel overnight and a large terminal in Oklahoma also rased its bid one cent. But dealers said they did not expect any significant surge in exports to move large amounts of wheat.
"Mills remain patient buyers," a Kansas dealer added.
Very slow turnaround times for railcars at the Gulf were adding to storage headaches in the country, dealers said.
"Most elevators around here are planning to store outside when the sorghum harvest starts in two weeks," said one Kansas dealer.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
